answer_1.quote: We apply our framework to generate ≈ 200K rationales using both proprietary and open-source LLMs... We generate each rationale category (e.g., intentions or presuppositions) using our framework separately... The rationales are textual explanations (INT, HR, PreSup) that are added as inputs to downstream models.
answer_1.outputs: Social rationales (intentions, hearer reactions, presuppositions) as free‑form text

answer_4.quote: We develop a rigorous annotation framework to assess the validity of generations based on three criteria: soundness, informativeness, and relevance. The evaluations were carried out by two annotators with a graduate level proficiency in English and at least five years of experience in computational linguistics and NLP.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators score each rationale on a Likert scale of 1 to 3 for soundness, informativeness, and relevance according to the defined criteria.
